name: Algorithms in Antipolo III 2025

venue.name: Robinsons Antipolo
venue.address: Sumulong Highway, L. Sumulong Memorial Circle, Antipolo, 1870 Metro Manila

information:
This is the third installment of Algorithms in Antipolo 2025!

The base registration fee is Php 400.00, good for 3 events. Addiional Php 50.00 will be added on top of the base registration for each event/puzzle you want to add. There is NO refunds under any circumstance. For more specific details, check [Payment Details tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AlgorithmsinAntipoloII2024#47914-payment-details).
